details: Lafferty is an American scientist, Professor at Yale University and leading researcher in machine learning. He is best known for proposing the Conditional Random Fields with Andrew McCallum and Fernando C.N. Pereira.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is John D. Lafferty — a small key that opens a big door.
